policy: No vendor is above Tier B and nothing is validated on a real device.
Tier B: a public byte-level signature we read ourselves plus a parser written from published research; unvalidated on real devices.
Tier C: no public byte-level storage documentation found; standard-export ingest and generic carving only; images are left unattributed.

Export formats listed for an OEM are what the cited vendor document says the product can export. Nirikshan has NOT tested any real export file from that OEM; ingest works for any container ffprobe recognises.
Source confidence: high = primary vendor/research document fetched and read; medium = primary document read in part; low = search-result snippet only (page not retrieved or not readable).

generic.standard_export_ingest: POST /api/cases/{id}/native-exports: hashed read-only copy, ffprobe container/stream description, no vendor claim. Tested with ffmpeg-generated MP4, MKV and AVI files only (tests/test_acquire_native.py).
generic.generic_carving: Vendor-agnostic H.264/H.265 Annex-B carving with orphan reporting; measured on reference images (docs/validation/results.md).

S1.title: Han, Jeong, Lee 2015, Analysis of the HIKVISION DVR File System
S1.says: Master Sector, HIKBTREE, RATS, OFNI layouts for one DVR

S2.title: Dragonas doctoral thesis 2023, chapters 4-5
S2.says: Hikvision logs on six devices; Dahua partition layouts and SQLite logs

S5.title: Yoon and Hwang 2026, arXiv:2605.07430 (Honeywell)
S5.says: GPT layout, Machine Data, Partition 1 structures, 20-byte custom header for one model

S14.title: ICICI Securities, Aditya Infotech IPO review (Jul 2025)
S14.says: Aditya Infotech (CP Plus) holds exclusive Dahua distribution rights in India
S14.does_not_say: anything about CP Plus recorder storage or container formats

R1.title: Matrix IPVS SATATYA NVR0801X Technical Specifications (PDF)
R1.says: Recording Format: AVI, Native; Compression H.265/H.264/Motion JPEG; Snapshot Format JPEG
R1.does_not_say: what 'Native' is, the on-disk storage layout, or any byte-level structure

R2.title: TP-Link VIGI FAQ 5043, How to Export Recording Using the PC Client
R2.says: Speed Mode exports recordings 'in the original format'; Compatible Mode converts recordings to H.264
R2.does_not_say: the container/file extension of either mode, or the NVR's on-disk format

R3.title: Uniview, How to backup Recording & image (PDF, 2019)
R3.says: default backup file format .mp4 to USB storage; .TS files when backing up to disc; file name 'camera name-recording start time' e.g. Ch9-20150630183546.mp4; USB device formatted FAT32 or NTFS
R3.does_not_say: the NVR's on-disk recording format or any byte-level structure

R4.title: AXIS Camera Station Pro datasheet (PDF)
R4.says: Export to ASF, MP4 and MKV; digital signature on exported recordings; standalone player; password protection when exporting to ZIP
R4.does_not_say: the recording storage format, or the signature scheme of signed exports

R5.title: Reolink support, Backup Recordings to USB Drive from PoE NVR
R5.says: check 'MP4 Format File' to export MP4, otherwise files are saved in H.264 format
R5.does_not_say: the NVR's on-disk format or USB file-system requirements

R6.title: Hanwha Vision support FAQ (backup formats), search-result snippet
R6.says: (snippet) backups as SEC (designated viewer), AVI (regular players), NVR (playable on the NVR only); Wisenet Viewer exports MP4, MKV or native Wisenet format
R6.does_not_say: any byte-level structure; the page itself could not be read

R7.title: Bosch/Keenfinity knowledge base, VRM eXport Wizard article, search-result snippet
R7.retrieved: 2026-10-09 (fetched page showed only an index; snippet only)
R7.says: (snippet) the VRM eXport Wizard copies video in its original format without transcoding; MP4 export; BVMS 10.0.1 replaced ASF export with MP4
R7.does_not_say: any byte-level structure; the article text could not be read

R8.title: IPVM discussion, Convert Avigilon .AVE file format to .MP4, search-result snippet
R8.says: (snippet) ACC Player exports native .AVE or .AVI video
R8.does_not_say: any byte-level structure of AVE or of recorder storage

oems.name: Hikvision

standard_export_support.detail: any ffprobe-recognised export container; no Hikvision export file tested

proprietary_storage_parsing.detail: Master Sector, RATS logs (bounded sample), HIKBTREE entries, OFNI counts, per the 2015 DVR layout [S1][S2]; H.264 only

deleted_video_recovery.detail: generic carving recovers blocks whose HIKBTREE entries were cleared; parser alone does not

limitations: Unvalidated on a real device; per-paper layout only (circular check)
Newer firmware, H.265, encrypted recordings not covered
Source conflicts (block size, timestamp basis, Master Sector base) unresolved

oems.name: Dahua

standard_export_support.detail: ffmpeg's dhav demuxer may describe .dav exports; not tested with a real Dahua export

proprietary_storage_parsing.detail: DHAV frame container only [S9]; DHFS internals are undocumented and not parsed

deleted_video_recovery.detail: DHAV frames are found wherever they survive; no file-system metadata is used

limitations: Unvalidated on a real device
DHFS, XFS partition and SQLite logs not parsed
Header checksum not verified (algorithm undocumented)

oems.name: Honeywell

proprietary_storage_parsing.detail: Machine Data, Partition 1 structures, 20-byte custom headers for ONE model (HN35080200) [S5]

deleted_video_recovery.detail: per-paper layout; generic carving covers bytes the parser does not explain

limitations: One model only; the Honeywell label does not imply one on-disk format
Unvalidated on a real device
H.265 and Partition 2 not analysed

oems.name: CP Plus

standard_export_support.detail: no CP Plus export documentation found; no CP Plus export file tested

limitations: The Dahua distribution relationship [S14] does NOT establish DHFS/DHAV use; not labelled Dahua-compatible
Needs one real image to determine filesystem and container

On-disk format unknown
